text:
olivia: Noticed odd behavior when promoting feature-flag defaults from org->team. Some teams keep old flag values after promote.
ben: Repro steps?
olivia: Promote org flag `beta_feature_on=true` -> console shows team-level inherits, but several teams still read false in runtime.
frank: Could be stale cache or ETag mismatch during publish swap. We recently changed the publish path to parallel writes.
yasmin: Any errors in apply logs?
ojosh: Saw 412s in the publish logs earlier today: `Precondition Failed: ETag mismatch`. If console didn't handle that, it may have retried with an empty body and overwritten.
olivia: That's scary. Console shows success. We need server to surface precondition failures back to UI.
ben: Agreed. Also think about semantics: when promoting, should we do a replace or a merge? Promote implies replace for child defaults, but we also have per-team overrides that must remain.
frank: Proposed: publish flow = generate new version blob for org defaults; compute effective per-team final-state server-side; then atomically point the namespace alias to new version only when all teams have a computed effective state. This avoids partial overwrites.
yasmin: Implementation note: our CDN caches flag blobs for 30s. Atomic alias flip needs to increment version and purge or use cache-keying with version id.
ojosh: For UI, show a post-publish "effective coverage" report listing teams that would change values and those with overrides unaffected.
olivia: Also we should honor `If-Match` on promote calls from console to avoid blind overwrites. If console's ETag is stale, return 412 and surface modal: "Promote failed due to concurrent change. Please refresh preview."
ben: Telemetry: emit `flag.promote.attempt` with fields `org_id`, `teams_touched`, `mode` and `flag_key`. Emit `flag.promote.etag_conflict` on 412s. Sample full payload 1%, metadata 100%.
yasmin: Rollout safety: add a `dry_run=true` param that returns the per-team deltas without committing. Console should default to dry_run first and require explicit confirm.
frank: Backwards-compat: some internal infra relies on old GET path that returned flat map. New versioned blob is nested. Add a compatibility shim for reading the flat map for older clients for N days and log deprecations.
ojosh: Also add server-side validation to reject payloads that include unknown fields like `overrides_list` vs `overrides_map`. Return structured error listing offending keys.
olivia: For large orgs, computing per-team effective state can be heavy. Suggest async preview job that the UI polls. Show progress and allow commit when ready.
yasmin: typo: yasmin will implement async preview + queue depth metrics.
ben: Ops note: ops-bot, any deploys around 1719801200?
ops-bot: deploy:flags-service v2.9.0 rolled at 1719801150 by ci-pipeline (feature: parallel-publish).
frank: That matches timeline. Let's throttle parallelism and enable a canary that uses atomic alias flip.
ojosh: I'll PR: 1) surface 412 to UI, 2) require If-Match on promote, 3) default console promote to dry_run, 4) telemetry schema.
yasmin: I'll add async preview endpoint and implement queue worker.
olivia: Thanks team. After PRs, run e2e on staging org with 2k teams and enable canary for 10% of orgs.
ops-bot: incident:flag-promote-anomaly created at 1719801405.
ben: tagging @josh and @yasmin for fixes. :thumbsup:
